accepted.hypothesis: Injecting 100% packet loss on the front-end service edge will cause all front-end requests to fail or hang, violating the golden journey.
accepted.expected_invariant: All golden journey steps return success status codes and satisfy contracts.

accepted.recovery_expectation: After removing loss, system should recover to baseline within washout period.
accepted.weakness_surface: front-end has no timeout on downstream calls; loss on the front-end edge directly blocks all user-facing traffic.

accepted.weakness_surface: front-end single replica no PDB; static_prediction: kill = total outage.
